po-lsd.label: IPL runs per slower ball in the death
po-lsd.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
po-lsd.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (6) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, CASE WHEN d.over_num <= 5 THEN 'Powerplay' WHEN d.over_num <= 14 THEN 'Middle' ELSE 'Death' END ph, CASE WHEN c.variation IN ('Slower ball','Off-cutter','Leg-cutter') THEN 'slow' ELSE 'stock' END dkind, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 AND (c.variation IN ('Slower ball','Off-cutter','Leg-cutter') OR c.length IS NOT NULL) AND d.bowler_id IN (SELECT d2.bowler_id FROM deliveries d2 JOIN delivery_commentary c2 ON c2.delivery_id = d2.delivery_id WHERE c2.variation IN ('Slower ball','Off-cutter','Leg-cutter') GROUP BY d2.bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) GROUP BY side, ph, dkind
